name: Observer
coreSense: Open attention with nothing in particular to attend to.
image: You're available, but no specific connection is being made right now. The situation is open and isn't asking anything of you, and this may continue for a while.

name: Preface
coreSense: Open, quiet availability beginning to tilt toward readiness to reach out.
image: Nothing has called your attention yet, but the orientation is shifting. You're not sending anything, not aimed at anyone, but the capacity to reach out is quietly coming online.

name: Sighting
coreSense: Wide open availability narrowing as one specific thing claims attention.
image: Something has surfaced from the general openness and is worth watching. No signal yet, but your attention is no longer diffuse. It's beginning to focus on one particular source.

name: Resolve
coreSense: Quiet availability crystallizing into a specific intention without acting yet.
image: A direction is forming out of the openness. Nothing has happened yet, but you're no longer just available. You're aimed at something, holding an intention that hasn't moved into action.

name: Influx
coreSense: Passive availability activating as input arrives from many directions at once.
image: The quiet has broken and things are coming in from everywhere. Nothing is sorted yet. The value right now is the breadth of what's arriving, not any particular piece of it.

name: Emergence
coreSense: Wide receptive silence reversing into wide active sending.
image: What was entirely inward is turning outward. The same open, distributed quality is now pushing out rather than waiting. Something moves from quiet availability into broad expression.

name: Arrival
coreSense: Diffuse availability finding its particular recipient at last.
image: One source is claiming your full attention, and the wide openness is focusing around it. This is what the readiness was for, even if you didn't know who or what it was readiness for.

name: Ignition
coreSense: Deep silence converting into full concentrated action.
image: The silence was real, and so is what breaks it. Whatever formed in that open, unhurried space has resolved into one specific act, fully committed, aimed at one target, nothing held back.

name: Fallow
coreSense: Latent outward reach turning inward into open, unfocused availability.
image: The capacity to reach out is real, but the orientation is shifting away from sending. Nothing is going out right now. The situation is opening to whatever comes in instead.

name: Reserve
coreSense: Wide latent reach holding steady, the capacity continuing in reserve.
image: You have the reach, the platform, the network, and nothing is going through it right now. The situation continues this way: real capacity, held quietly, not yet called into use.

name: Bearing
coreSense: Wide silent reserve beginning to orient toward one specific source.
image: The broad, undirected capacity is starting to narrow its attention without yet receiving anything. One direction is gaining weight, though no signal has arrived and no move has been made.

name: Draw
coreSense: Broad silent capacity sharpening toward one specific target.
image: The wide, undirected reach is pulling together and pointing somewhere specific. The action isn't taken yet, but the broad reserve is no longer scattered. It's all behind one intended direction.

name: Canvass
coreSense: Silent outward reserve reversing into wide active intake.
image: The readiness to reach out has flipped into a readiness to take in. What was poised to speak is now listening, and not to one thing but to many. The whole field is coming in at once.

name: Release
coreSense: Latent outward capacity activating as the signal finally forms.
image: The reach was real all along, and now there's something to send through it. The platform, the network, the wide potential audience are all being used now, the signal going out across the whole field.

name: Mooring
coreSense: Wide diffuse reserve narrowing and reversing into deep focused reception.
image: The broad, outward-leaning capacity is pulling inward and focusing on one thing. Something specific is now claiming everything the situation has. The wide silence becomes a deep, particular listening.

name: Commission
coreSense: Wide held capacity collecting and firing as one concentrated act.
image: Everything that was held in reserve is being aimed at one specific place. The distributed readiness collapses into a single focused line, and the full force of what was waiting goes there.

name: Aperture
coreSense: Pointed vigil loosening into wide, unfocused availability.
image: The specific thing you were watching for hasn't come, or something has shifted, and the tight waiting is opening outward. You're available again to whatever the situation offers, aimed at nothing in particular.

name: Threshold
coreSense: Focused inward waiting beginning to tilt toward outward reach.
image: The pointed attention that was watching one source is starting to turn around. Nothing is going out yet, but the situation is shifting from waiting-to-receive toward readiness-to-reach-out.

name: Vigil
coreSense: Focused waiting holding steady, the expectant attention continuing.
image: You're watching for something from one specific source, and the watching continues. Nothing has arrived, but the attention hasn't wavered. The same pointed readiness, sustained through time.

name: Pivot
coreSense: Focused inward vigil flipping into focused outward intention.
image: What you were waiting to receive has resolved into something you intend to do. The focus holds perfectly through the reversal. Same precision, same singularity, just pointing outward now instead of in.

name: Breach
coreSense: Narrow focused vigil broken open by signal arriving from many directions.
image: It wasn't the signal you were waiting for, but the field has answered anyway, widely, from many directions at once. The pointed waiting is flooded by broad incoming signal, and the breadth is the value now.

name: Exhale
coreSense: Inward focused vigil reversing into wide outward sending.
image: The held attention breathes out across a broad field. What was gathered inward is releasing without fixing on any single target. The closed, pointed watching opens into something that moves in all directions.

name: Answer
coreSense: Focused vigil met by the signal it was waiting for.
image: The source you were watching has arrived. The connection that was held expectantly is now carrying what it was configured to carry. The waiting and the receiving are one continuous state finding its completion.

name: Return
coreSense: Focused waiting converting into focused action, attention becomes commitment.
image: The vigil is over, not abandoned but fulfilled as its energy turns outward. The same singularity that was watching one source is now sending everything to one target, fully committed, nothing held back.

name: Prospect
coreSense: Focused intention releasing into wide, unfocused availability.
image: The aim is loosening without having fired. The sharp intention is giving way to something wider and more open. No particular target, no particular source, just a broad availability to whatever the field offers.

name: Poise
coreSense: Focused readiness joined by a second latent capacity, nothing yet sent.
image: One intention is already formed and aimed, and a second kind of readiness is coming online alongside it. Broad reach, available in many directions, held live but silent. Two forms of reserve accumulating at once.

name: Inversion
coreSense: Focused outward intention turning into focused inward waiting.
image: The aim was outward, ready to send to one specific place. Now the same precision is pointing in the other direction, holding on one source, waiting for something to arrive from it instead of sending.

name: Brace
coreSense: Held intention continuing, the focused readiness persisting without releasing.
image: The intention is formed and aimed, and it stays that way. The moment to act hasn't come, and the holding is deliberate. One specific target, the full readiness maintained, the decision to wait kept.

name: Survey
coreSense: Focused outward intention loosening into wide active intake.
image: The fixed aim is releasing into something wider. Input is arriving from many directions now, and the posture has shifted from locked-on-one-target to open-to-everything-at-once. The field has more to say than the single target suggested.

name: Scatter
coreSense: Focused intention dispersing into wide outward sending.
image: The energy is going out, but not to the single target it was aimed at. It goes to many at once, spread across a wide field. What was held for one becomes available to many.

name: Yield
coreSense: Outward intention reversing into inward reception, readiness to give becoming openness to receive.
image: The aim is turning around, and the focus holds through the reversal. The same single-point precision is now open to receive rather than poised to send. A prepared offering that becomes instead a prepared receiving.

name: Dispatch
coreSense: Held intention releasing into full concentrated action at last.
image: The readiness has become an act. The signal that was held goes to one specific place with full force, nothing scattered, nothing withheld. This is the direct completion of what was aimed.

name: Lull
coreSense: Wide active intake settling into wide passive availability.
image: The busy gathering is stilling. The breadth stays, but the active pulling-in eases into patient openness. Available to whatever arrives, no longer sweeping and sorting, just present to the field.

name: Crest
coreSense: Wide active intake tilting toward wide latent reach.
image: The gathering is reaching a turning point. Nothing is going out yet, but broad outward capacity is coming online alongside the intake. A platform readying itself, reach in many directions preparing to hold something.

name: Catch
coreSense: Wide active intake narrowing as one thing claims the full attention.
image: One source in the broad reception has become interesting in a way the others haven't. The wide sweep is contracting around it. No signal yet, but the searching phase is over and the watching has begun.

name: Elect
coreSense: Wide active intake resolving into a single focused intention.
image: Out of everything the scan found, one thing is being selected and committed to. The breadth collapses into a point: the research is done, one direction has been chosen, and the aim is set.

name: Sweep
coreSense: Wide active intake sustaining itself, the broad gathering continuing.
image: Input keeps arriving from the whole field and the situation stays that way. Wide open, nothing filtered, nothing committed to yet. The value is in the accumulation. Nothing needs to narrow right now.

name: Relay
coreSense: Wide active intake reversing into wide active sending.
image: What was coming in across a wide front is now going out across a wide front. The distribution holds in both directions. Gathered from many, passed on to many, without collapsing the plurality on either side.

name: Landing
coreSense: Wide active intake narrowing into deep focused reception.
image: The broad scan is settling at last on one source. The restless gathering becomes deep and still as the connection focuses down to one thing coming in fully. The searching is over. The listening is beginning.

name: Distill
coreSense: Wide active intake resolving into one concentrated outward act.
image: Everything that was gathered widely is being converted into one precise signal going to one place. The breadth has been processed down. A long intake phase ending in the one thing to say, said once, to the right place.

name: Echo
coreSense: Wide active sending settling into wide passive availability.
image: The broadcast is stilling. The breadth stays, but the active sending eases. What was pushing out is now simply present to the field, open to whatever comes back, not aimed at anything.

name: Recess
coreSense: Wide active sending pulling back into wide latent reserve.
image: The sending is stopping, but the reach isn't going away. The platform, the network, the wide audience all stay live. Nothing is going through it right now. The capacity is intact and the message has paused.

name: Gather
coreSense: Wide outward sending narrowing into focused inward watching.
image: The broad outward sending is contracting and reversing. Where there was dispersal there is now focus. Where there was outward motion there is now inward readiness. Something in the wide field is worth watching specifically.

name: Tether
coreSense: Wide diffuse sending collapsing into one specific aimed intention.
image: The signal that was going out to many is being collected and aimed at one place. The many have resolved into the one. Something in the broadcast has named a destination, and the connection is now pointed there.

name: Upturn
coreSense: Wide outward sending reversing into wide inward intake.
image: The direction flips while the breadth holds. The same wide-open, distributed quality that was sending outward is now pulling inward. Everything the field has is arriving at once.

name: Open Channel
coreSense: Wide active sending sustaining itself, the broadcast continuing.
image: The signal keeps going out across the wide field and the situation stays that way. Distributed, diffuse, outward. No narrowing, no pulling back. The connection is broad and it remains broad.

name: Attend
coreSense: Wide outward sending narrowing and reversing into deep focused reception.
image: The broadcast is giving way to one specific voice. The wide dispersal is contracting and turning around until the channel is fully open to one source. The one who was speaking to a crowd stops to listen to one person in it.

name: Forge
coreSense: Wide diffuse sending concentrating into one full directed act.
image: The broad reach is being gathered into a single line. What was available to everyone is now fully committed to one specific place. The distribution collapses, and the focused act that remains carries everything behind it.

name: Soften
coreSense: Deep focused reception easing into wide, unfocused availability.
image: The close, committed listening is opening out. The single source that held all the attention is releasing it into something more diffuse. Available to whatever comes, no longer held to one thing.

name: Surface
coreSense: Deep inward reception beginning to orient toward outward reach.
image: The deep listening is starting to look up. Wide reach is becoming available alongside it, a platform, a network, held live but still silent. What was received hasn't been sent yet, but the sending capacity is waking.

name: Linger
coreSense: Active deep reception becoming expectant vigil as the signal fades.
image: Something was arriving fully, and now it has gone quiet. The attention stays pointed at the same source, expecting more. The conversation has paused but not ended, and the channel holds its position.

name: Turning
coreSense: Focused inward reception pivoting into focused outward intention.
image: What was taken in is becoming something to give. The deep reception is pivoting into a held intention. Same precision, same singularity, the direction reversing. The listening is ending and the response is about to begin.

name: Widen
coreSense: Deep focused reception opening into wide active intake.
image: The single source is giving way to many. The close attention is expanding outward, pulling in from across the field. What required full focus on one thing is becoming a wide and busy gathering.

name: Offering
coreSense: Deep inward reception reversing into wide outward sending.
image: What came in through a narrow, specific connection goes out through a wide, open one. The close listening is becoming a broadcast. Nothing held back, nothing aimed precisely, the signal spreading across the field.

name: Immersion
coreSense: Deep focused reception holding steady, the close listening sustained.
image: The connection to one source stays fully open and keeps going. One person, one work, one experience. Nothing narrowing further, nothing widening. The same depth of attention that was present continues to be present.

name: Passage
coreSense: Deep reception becoming full concentrated action, the taken-in becoming the given-out.
image: The deep intake has become a deep output. The same singularity, the same full commitment, and only the direction has reversed. Someone who has listened fully to one person now speaks fully in return.

name: Repose
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending releasing into wide, passive availability.
image: The focused effort is easing, not switching to another target but opening. The directional sending is releasing into something diffuse and still. Available to whatever arrives, no message queued, just present to the field.

name: Interval
coreSense: Concentrated sending pulling back into wide latent reserve.
image: The signal is stopping, but the reach isn't going away. What was focused and committed to one place is becoming broad, live, and silent. The same outward capacity held in reserve while the specific work pauses.

name: Spend
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending shifting into focused inward waiting.
image: You've said everything you had to say to one place, and now you go quiet, listening for what comes back. The same singularity and point-to-point quality stay intact. Only the direction has reversed.

name: Sustain
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending converting to focused outward intention.
image: The active sending has paused, but the direction stays fixed. The connection is still real, still aimed at the same place. It's just not carrying anything right now. The work is on hold, not over.

name: Harvest
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending reversing into wide active intake.
image: The focused giving is over for now, and the situation is opening wide to take in from everywhere. The sharp, committed outward act is becoming a broad, open receiving. Replenished from the whole field.

name: Diffuse
coreSense: Concentrated point-to-point sending widening into diffuse outward broadcast.
image: The same energy that was going to one receiver is spreading out to many. The precise line opens wide. What was held for one becomes available to a broad field, the aim releasing without changing direction.

name: Exchange
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending reversing into concentrated inward reception.
image: The direction reverses while the focus holds perfectly. The same total commitment, the same point-to-point quality, but the energy is no longer going out. It's coming in, from one source, received fully.

name: Full Tilt
coreSense: Concentrated outward commitment sustaining itself, the focused act continuing.
image: One target, all active energy going there, nothing scattered, and this continues. The situation isn't building to a peak or about to change. This is what it looks like when full commitment is the ongoing state.
